richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Jamalpur

c: Old railway towns like Jamalpur, home to one of India's oldest locomotive workshops, have colony grounds lined with large, mature trees. Those trees give welcome shade, but their roots and falling branches need thought when you plan an outdoor gym. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to railway colonies, schools, institutes and public parks in Jamalpur, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,540 km away.

Bihar's summers are hot and humid, and the monsoon is heavy along the Ganga. A shaded spot under old trees is the most comfortable place to exercise, as long as the machines sit clear of thick roots. We dispatch by road and fit the equipment through our team or a dealer in eastern India, grouted or self-standing. Send us photos that show the trees around the site. We will mark safe positions for each station on a layout drawing.

richText.heading: Placing machines under old shade trees

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines be installed under trees?
items.a: Yes, with care. Place the bases clear of thick roots and away from dead branches. We mark suitable spots on the layout drawing after looking at your site photos.

items.q: Which machines suit a railway colony ground?
items.a: A mix of gentle and strength machines, such as seated twisters, Tai Chi wheels and a rider. They serve retired staff and younger residents on the same ground.
Yes. We dispatch from our factory in Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India, as per the approved layout.
